protocol.reference_difference: floor window_nll scores 511 at float32 in cached 64-token steps; lead amendment explicitly requires 512 at fp64 and permits full prefill

model.weight_hash_verification: pending separate host receipt; blob filename is not a verification

protocol.adapter_compute_dtype: default bfloat16 from MiniCPM3_TC.from_pretrained; matches registration

g0.per_model_process_guard: A/B six-window scores vs fresh repeat-1 baselines at <=0.001 before SP; preserve r1 in-process safeguard

protocol.predictions: lead P1-P5 and seat S1-S5 retained verbatim in registration; P2 uses fresh B; S1 historical-protocol premise retired, no post-result replacement
